newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices fall, market down on offerings.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices fall, market down on offerings.

text.p: Indian sugar prices fell on Thursday with physical buying remaining low while increased mill offerings held back rates, dealers said.
Ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 2/5 rupees to 1,235/1,265 rupees per quintal and M-30 eased by 15 to 1,250/1,318 rupees.
"Sugar mill delivery however remained unquoted as most of the delivery tenders out of the free sale quota for November are exhausted," one broker said.
The quota for December is 800,000 tonnes and traders are awaiting state-wise allocation, he said.
